focus_revision_note: Pre-delivery QA found lead mentions of Rwanda in country lists/historical analogies, Red Sea in Horn-of-Africa-only articles, and Gaza in articles primarily about Sudan. All new additions therefore require a neutral title match; Red Sea titles also need Yemen/Houthi geographic context in the body. SAMIDRC is a neutral named mission alias, not an event-outcome filter. This improves precision at a known cost to recall and introduces an explicit headline-language selection bias. No source article or original window date is changed.
revision_reason: The delivered v2 has 44 unfilled publisher-window quotas. Preserve its 116 records exactly; broaden the accessible editorial-source panel and fill window totals without altering dates. Original GV/VOA quotas are reported separately and are not claimed complete by substituting another publisher.
selection: New URLs and normalized text must not occur in the delivered v2 or existing development data. Require neutral case aliases in the title (initial title/lead discovery remains logged); this is a scope screen, not human relevance verification. Within each window prefer the currently least represented available publisher, rotate calendar months, then rank by SHA256(seed|window|publisher|URL). Exclude exact/title/strong text near-duplicates. Never select on event labels or detector scores. Leave unfilled totals visible.
label_policy: All additions unassigned, pending, labels:null, relevance_verified:false, negative_label_verified:false, historical_snapshot_verified:false. Calendar sampling is not a verified peaceful period or a negative label.
source_policy: Use only individually attributable available original full text under a verified source reuse policy. Record commentary/analysis separately from reporting and distinguish named editorial sources from outlets they cite. Retain source hyperlinks and licensing metadata; no images or media. Source availability is a selection limitation, not representative media coverage.
freeze_policy: Never modify the delivered v2, fixed 60 review articles, train/validation files or frozen model. Never overwrite a changed v3 review record. Original snapshots and current audit findings remain separate.
